notes.title: War, the Game: v6.4 New tracks, nations and bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Version v6.4 contains

- 3 Brand new tracks by solidaudioworks (www.solidaudioworks.com).
The production company by some of the talented people responsible for the audio of the Grand Theft Auto series.

- The smaller nations in the game are now selectable through 'Pick your Nation' scenario. Nepal can finally beat China. Wales can take over the world.

- Various minor bug fixes. (Nuclear leak fixed)

notes.title: War, the Game: Update (v5.7) out now.
notes.notes:
Version 5.7 of 'War, the Game' is now live. (Jan 21 2015)

A new sandbox type scenario called 'Turmoil'.
12 nations are scattered all over the globe. Be the one that ends up on top.

Streamlined Tutorial. Gone are the repetitions and screens full of text.

Bugs fixed:

Random crash. Some players experienced crashes that would occur at a certain point in a scenario. (ie March 2018)

The game now runs properly in 3840x2160.

Savegames now work even if your windows username has non latin chars in it.
